title: Upper Kula water transmission line improvements
summary: Bill 166 would add $350,000 for upper Kula water transmission improvements. The money comes from estimated revenues from licenses and permits for the Department of Water Supply. A council member noted that two diversions were destroyed in 2018 by Hurricane Olivia.
